themes.name: Agentic AI development
themes.description: Articles discussing the creation, capabilities, limitations, and practical application of autonomous AI agents in various development and research contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools that assist developers in writing, understanding, and debugging code, including their effectiveness and trustworthiness.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Articles highlighting AI tools and platforms designed to streamline or enhance the research process in specific domains, such as legal research.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: This theme covers articles where authors test, compare, and assess the performance and utility of various AI tools and models.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles exploring the application of AI in the design process and in user research activities, including ideation and analysis.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Content related to using AI for analyzing large datasets to extract insights, identify patterns, and inform decision-making.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Articles addressing the ethical considerations, biases, and trustworthiness of AI systems when applied to research and decision-making.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the research and development of AI chatbots, particularly their conversational capabilities and how to influence their output.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles discussing how AI can be utilized to support product managers in their decision-making, strategy, and execution.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: This theme covers AI tools and techniques used for creating new content, such as text, code, or media.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
